activity_summary: You tried the waking twice in his cadence, once as a piece that makes the room wait and once slower, and both times it was still yours. The third time you stopped. No. His. It's his. The queen stays unwritten on top of the leaf. Not tonight.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Tried the cadence twice, kept the third, and stopped.

entities.name: A Midsummer Night's Dream
entities.context: Mentioned in No. His. It's his.

facets.activity: Stopped on the third try and called the line Kemp's

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: That is his mouth. Too many of my joints in it.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The queen stays where she is. On top of this, when I get to her. Not tonight.
